preconditions: An annotation pins exact prototype and story content digests; save both pins before editing either endpoint.

steps.action: Edit current prototype and story content without changing the annotation.
steps.expected_result: The annotation is not current and reports both changed endpoint pins.

steps.action: Read the annotation after both endpoint content digests change.
steps.expected_result: Its original exact prototype and story digests remain unchanged rather than retargeting current content.

content.title: Expose both stale annotation pins
